description: Source code for Kubernetes client-go scale utilities, including resource and scale kind resolution, conversion between scale versions, and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: discoveryScaleResolver
classes.description: Implements ScaleKindResolver using discovery client to find scale subresources.

classes.name: cachedScaleKindResolver
classes.description: Caches results of ScaleKindResolver to optimize repeated lookups.

classes.name: ScaleConverter
classes.description: Handles conversion between different external scale versions.

methods.name: ScaleForResource
methods.description: Returns the GroupVersionKind of the scale subresource for a given resource.

methods.name: NewDiscoveryScaleKindResolver
methods.description: Creates a new ScaleKindResolver using discovery client.

methods.name: Scheme
methods.description: Returns the scheme used by ScaleConverter.

methods.name: Codecs
methods.description: Returns the CodecFactory used for encoding/decoding.

methods.name: ConvertToVersion
methods.description: Converts an external scale object to a specified group-version.
